scoring_justification: Exact n_k and η(k) numbers are only given as figures; we score derived structural properties (total density, monotonicity, temperature trends) and the transition temperature threshold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference total number densities (Table I) and transition temperature (≈2500 K) from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper J. Chem. Phys. 152, 224705 (2020), Table I and Section IV.A
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's tabulated and stated values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own numerical data for the exact same quantities and units.

outputs.description: Cluster size distributions n_k for three temperatures (4006, 5005, 6004 K).
Ensemble-averaged structure parameter η(k) from MD for cluster sizes 2..26 at each temperature.

schema.content: A single line containing a floating-point number representing T0 in Kelvin.

outputs.description: Solid-to-chain structural transition temperature T0 estimated from MD reduced structure parameter fit.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are compared to hidden reference values from the paper. The size distributions and structure parameters are evaluated using appropriate error metrics; the transition temperature is checked within a tolerance window.

steps.description: Cluster size distributions: total density match and monotonicity
Structure parameters η(k): physical range and monotonic temperature ordering
Transition temperature T0 must be close to 2500 K
